|death=Between [[50 BBY]] and [[48 BBY]], [[Raxus Secundus]]<ref name="Date">"Choices" depicts [[Mace Windu]] gaining a seat on the [[Jedi High Council]]. {{Film|III}} established that [[Anakin Skywalker]] was the youngest to ever serve on the Council. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the film to [[19 BBY]] and Skywalker's birth to [[41 BBY]]. Therefore, Windu must have been at least twenty-two years old. According to the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' booklet "[[Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force|Mace Windu and Other Force Users]]," Mace Windu was born forty years before the [[Battle of Naboo]], which ''Star Wars: Timelines'' places in [[32 BBY]]. Therefore, Windu gained a seat on the Council no earlier than [[50 BBY]]. ''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' further establishes that Windu is part of the Jedi Council at the [[time]] of [[Nim Pianna]]'s [[Mutiny on the Advent|death]], which ''Timelines'' dates to [[48 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of "Choices" must take place between these two years.</ref>

'''Katri''' was a [[Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master]] and member of the [[Jedi Order]]'s [[Jedi High Council]].<ref name="TOTJ" /> Between [[50 BBY]] and [[48 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> she was [[Death|killed]] by a group of [[security guard]]s on [[Raxus Secundus]], and her death was investigated by [[Jedi Master]]s [[Mace Windu]] and [[Dooku]]. Her seat on the [[Jedi Council]] was awarded to Windu.<ref name="TOTJ" />
